title: GitHub CLI (gh) configuration
description: Configuration settings for gh. See https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_config

spinner.description: Whether to use an animated spinner as a progress indicator.

accessible_prompter.description: Whether an accessible prompter should be used.

accessible_colors.description: Whether customizable, 4-bit accessible colors should be used.

color_labels.description: Whether to display labels using their RGB hex color codes in terminals that support truecolor.

browser.description: The web browser to use for opening URLs. If blank, will refer to environment.

http_unix_socket.description: The path to a Unix socket through which to make an HTTP connection. If blank, HTTP traffic will be handled by net/http.DefaultTransport.

pager.description: The terminal pager program to send standard output to (e.g. 'less'). Set to 'cat' to disable the pager.

prefer_editor_prompt.description: Toggle preference for editor-based interactive prompting in the terminal.

prompt.description: Toggle interactive prompting in the terminal. This is a global config that cannot be overridden by hostname.

editor.description: The text editor program to use for authoring text (e.g. when creating issues, pull requests). If blank, will refer to environment.

git_protocol.description: The protocol to use for git clone and push operations.

aliases.description: Aliases allow you to create nicknames for gh commands. Keys are alias names, values are command expansions (may be a simple command string or a shell command prefixed with '!').
